title: Coproduct of copies of a scheme is etale over it
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $I$ a countable set. The coproduct $U=\coprod_{i\in I}T$ exists in the category of schemes; each coprojection $\iota_i:T	o U$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], in particular a monomorphism, so $T	imes_{\iota_i,U,\iota_i}T=T$; the images of the $\iota_i$ cover $U$; for $i
e j$ the fibre product $T	imes_{\iota_i,U,\iota_j}T$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is the empty scheme; and the codiagonal $
abla:U	o T$ (the morphism with $
abla\circ\iota_i=\mathrm{id}_T$ for all $i$) is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], so $(U,
abla)$ is an object of the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ and $\{\iota_i:T	o U\}_{i\in I}$ is a covering of $U$ in $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site].
